title: In-situ TEM Observation of Electron Beam-Sensitive Material using the Nano Analysis Function
content: In recent years, various functional materials have been developed with the aim of achieving a decarbonized society. One method to clarify the relationship between the "nano-structure" and "function" of such materials is in-situ observation using a Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM). However, many functional materials are prone to damage from the irradiated electron beam. It is particularly important to be cautious about the potential effects of the electron beam on reactions during in-situ TEM observation.
